title: Friday Storytime
seo_title: Friday Storytime at Lebanon-Laclede County Library
description: Friday Storytime is a kids' program where families sing songs, read a few books, make a craft and have a snack. It covers the same theme as the Wednesday and Thursday sessions and is typically geared towards children of all ages. It takes place Friday, December 18, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM at the Lebanon-Laclede County Library, 915 South Jefferson Ave in Lebanon, MO.
